title: Home feed service and its tests
name: Home feed assembly

questions.prompt: Is there a defect in these tests that could make any of them pass on some runs and fail on others? If so, mark the line(s) where it is; otherwise answer that there is none.
In "respects the limit", why is the first returned post "post 4"?
choices: Because homeFeed reverses the per-author list before merging
Because Map iteration returns the most recently set entry first
Because the ids sort descending and the sort compares ids
Because SteppingClock gives each publish a timestamp 1 second later, and homeFeed sorts by createdAt descending

questions.prompt: Two posts in the candidate list have identical createdAt values. How does homeFeed order them?
choices: In the order they were pushed into candidates, because Array.prototype.sort is stable

questions.prompt: Why does the test file create a new FeedService inside each test instead of sharing one across the describe block?
choices: Posts and the id counter live in the instance, so a shared instance would leak posts between tests and make results depend on test order
FeedService cannot be constructed inside beforeEach
node:test runs tests in separate processes, so a shared instance would not be visible
homeFeed caches results per user on first call
